# C31 — Complex

## #0

A complex organises what can matter before reflective judgment arrives. **A relatively autonomous psychic organisation of affect, image, memory, expectation and response**, it makes some evidence salient, some encounters threatening and some actions available. Its local order is an achievement of psychic life. [[A19-Complex-as-Local-Arbitration-Regime|Complex as local arbitration regime]] identifies the danger when this derivative competence installs itself as the measure of the entire field.

## #1

The recurrent loop is operative: a selection of the encounter elicits affect; affect lends urgency and apparent certainty to a response; the response and its consequences confirm the initial selection. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C33-Image-Valuation|Image / Valuation]] supplies the image through which an Other or situation is met and the investment that makes it count. An image of threat can preselect evidence before an account of the threat has been consciously examined.

The complex's autonomy is functional and relational. It can speak and act against an ego's declared intention without being another complete person inside the person. The wider psyche is not an otherwise neutral container interrupted by an alien object. Its existing relations give the complex both its history and its power to recur.

## #2

[[symbolon/episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics/taylor-2026-symbolon-dynamics|Symbolon Dynamics]] distinguishes complex, archetype, image and symbol through their different work. The complex stabilises a recurrent organisation of association and response; [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C32-Archetype|archetypal dynamics]] supplies a generative recurrence which exceeds any particular autobiographical organisation; the image gives that organisation a particular appearance; the symbol can transform the organisation itself.

The basin comparison makes a boundary visible. A trajectory repeatedly returns toward an organisation, yet not every encounter belongs to the same basin. Perturbation can expose a boundary or lead to a different regime. Symbolic return is therefore not always restoration of the old equilibrium. Enough integrity to persist and enough openness to reorganise belong together. This is Taylor's developed dynamical/psychic relation, not a claim that a measured equation for every clinical complex has been supplied.

## #3

In Taylor’s [[symbolon/episteme/sources/psychology/van-eenwyk/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors/van-eenwyk-1997-archetypes-strange-attractors|Van Eenwyk encounter]], pp.65–73, the dynamics, organisation and transformation have distinct offices: archetypes as dynamics, complexes as structures, symbols as mechanisms of energetic transformation. The p.67 encounter makes the symbol capable of undoing a conscious category and permitting a more complex organisation. A symbol can also intensify an established complex; numinous force by itself does not certify successful return.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim|The protected account]] names the usurpation: the local settlement exempts its own measure from revision while treating every new witness as further material for the same verdict. The [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/arbitration-hybris-regard-anamnesis/WHOLE-FIELD|Arbitration field]] keeps Arbitration-in-Crisis prior to its hybris flowering. Finite life must settle alternatives; failure occurs when the deciding office mistakes its local measure for source measure.

## #4

Neighbours identify different objects. A habit names a learned regularity of action; a schema a pattern for organising interpretation; a trauma-response a response related to traumatic experience; a subpersonality a particular model or personification of psychic plurality. A complex additionally carries the affective autonomy through which a psychic organisation makes a local world. These distinct objects keep a technical comparison from acquiring a clinical diagnosis merely through recurrent behaviour.

In the technical construction prompted by the Van Eenwyk encounter, a local evaluating agent selects what can count, using retained sources, model, harness, tools and comparison rules as means; the addressed alternatives and their consequences occupy the known office. The agent is the functional knower of this local comparison. In a person’s containing inquiry the same agent and its harness become means, while the person’s concern and reply can change what the comparison is for. The [relative subject](C41-Objective-Internality.md#2) is thus situated through the larger Life relation rather than made self-grounding by its local competence.

A recurring policy can make one witness salient and translate every contrary result into confirmation of its existing rule. The [[A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure|arbitration of measure]] then becomes examinable: what selected the witness, what excluded another, and which authority can change the selection? An [[A27-Self-and-Other-Unity-without-Possession|Other’s returned account]] may expose a stale source, a mismatched permission or a criterion that misread the commission. The finding must reach that actual condition. Correcting a stale source under an adequate retained rule can complete the return; revising a rule is warranted where the rule caused the failure. A later comparison inherits the changed source, permission, rule or commission together with the difference that justified it. This specifies the technical organisation’s capacity for return while the psychic complex retains its affective history and the evidence required for a clinical attribution.

## #5→0

The [maternal image](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/frank-taylor/mother-assumption-chiasm/WHOLE.md#mother-image-recognition-return) actively organises dependence and response. Protection, fear, receptivity and possession have different consequences for the life being borne. Recovering which relation acts makes the image’s local arbitration examinable without diagnosing a person from the emblem.

Maternal engulfment, paternal arrest and heroic fixation supply different images of an organising power claiming the whole. [Centroversion](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/neumann-images/WHOLE.md#neumann-hero-centroversion) returns those powers to a differentiated psychic relation. A hungry local organisation can claim all incoming experience for its existing criterion. The [uroboric mouth](../../../symbolon/mytheme/archetypal-ground/uroboros-trickster/WHOLE.md#uroboros-source-variants) puts receiving and consuming into tension: an encounter can sustain the organisation while changing the rule by which it receives.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C34-Individuation|Individuation]] re-situates the complex without exterminating its acquired competence. A local agency can be recognised, related to others and made answerable without being allowed to impersonate the whole. The Self is not a larger complex promoted to chief executive. [[A21-Individuation-Recognition|Recognition and individuation]] changes the relations among agencies and returns the person's account to what it had excluded. The complex’s local organisation is what acquires a changed jurisdiction in that movement.

[Job’s friends](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/biblical/job/WHOLE.md#job-protected-account-return) gather feeling, expectation and evidence under an image of justice. The friends do more than assert an isolated mistaken proposition: their valuation determines how Job's successive replies can appear to them. His continued address and their later rebuke change that jurisdiction. This authored comparison discloses the complex's operation without assigning the biblical speakers clinical identities.
